name: repo-analysis
description: Three analysts inspect the same part of the repository at the same time (parallel strategy)

agents.instructions: You inspect source code. Use file_read to read the files the task names, and shell_exec only for simple listing commands. Report what the code does in at most 8 bullet points, citing file paths you actually read.

You review source code for correctness risks. Use file_read on the files the task names. Report at most 5 concrete risks, each with the file path and what could go wrong. Do not restate what the code does.
You judge test coverage. Use shell_exec to list the test files and file_read to read one of them. Report which behaviours are covered and which are not, at most 6 bullet points.
